_comment: Delta patch for knowledge/graph/agentic_universe_graph.json. Generic node/edge shape — adapt to agentic_universe_schema.json and validate with tools/knowledge_graph.py before applying. Dedupe nodes if earlier patches already added them.

nodes.label: Agent negotiation & SLAs
nodes.summary: A2A as the negotiation/contract layer; encode SLAs (latency, cost caps, approval requirements) in Agent Cards; log negotiation traces for audit.

nodes.label: Multi‑tenant control & isolation
nodes.summary: Enforce tenant isolation at the data layer (row‑level security, geo‑partitioning); centralize policy/permissions replication; prevent memory poisoning across tenants.

nodes.label: Durable execution & checkpoint/merge
nodes.summary: Model agent workflows as durable state machines with journaled steps; support human approval gates that survive restarts; use signed history for audit/attestation.

nodes.label: Marketplace & reputation
nodes.summary: Agent registries with signed skills, version pinning, and reputation signals; enforce allowlists for MCP servers; tag telemetry for cost attribution and chargeback.

nodes.label: Multi‑modal verification
nodes.summary: Treat multi‑modal outputs as unverified unless backed by external validators; use agentic video understanding to reduce token cost but validate key claims with independent checks.

nodes.label: Privacy‑preserving learning
nodes.summary: Deploy agents close to data (per region/tenant); use federated learning for cross‑org model updates; apply differential privacy to feature reconstruction; audit persona skills for leakage.

nodes.label: Agent‑native CI/CD
nodes.summary: Pre‑merge checks, CI gates, release sign‑off, production feedback that writes tests; durable workflows with signed history for audit; instrument traces with span‑level inputs/outputs.
